title.en: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe

summary.en: For months, people have wondered when OpenAI will go public. CEO Sam Altman says it won't happen until the company can make better promises about model safety, with no firm timeli…
summary.zh: 几个月来，人们一直在想OpenAI什么时候上市。首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼（ Sam Altman ）表示，除非公司能够对模型安全性做出更好的承诺，否则不会发生这种情况。

title.en: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it’s not a glitch
title.zh: 当您询问有关Minecraft的信息时， America.gov会变得非常奇怪，但这并不是一个小故障

summary.en: For the sake of national security, it's a relief to learn that America.gov is not hallucinating to the point that it's penning lengthy poetry.
summary.zh: 为了国家安全，得知America.gov没有产生幻觉，以至于它正在写冗长的诗歌，这是一种解脱。

title.en: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
